sentences.en: The old house was run-down and needed serious repairs.
sentences.zh: 那座老房子破旧不堪，需要进行大修。

sentences.en: After working overtime for weeks, she felt completely run-down.
sentences.zh: 连续加班几周后，她感到筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: The neighborhood had become a run-down area with many abandoned buildings.
sentences.zh: 这个社区成了一个破败的地区，有很多废弃的大楼。
